To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the GA representation that uses the sequence-dependent setup times (SDST) representation outperforms all the other seven representations in terms of the quality of the solutions and the computational times.
the GA with a permutation representation is superior to all the other representations in terms of the number of solutions generated, computational time and quality of solutions.

the best representation for the GA is the one that uses the job permutation and the machine sequence as the representation, while the worst representation for the GA was the one that uses a permutation of the jobs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
(1) a comparison of the performance of the eight different representations of GA for the JSP, (2) a comparison of two crossover operators, and (3) a comparison of three mutation operators.

(1) the effect of the number of genes on the performance of the algorithm; (2) the effect of different initial population generation schemes; (3) the effect of using different crossover and mutation operators; (4) the effect of applying the GA with different representations for the same problem.
the following questions: Which representation is better?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in general, the GA performs well under the representation in which the chromosome is a permutation of the job sequence and the machine sequence.
, for the JSP, the GA’s performance is representation dependent.
the representation of the JSP as a sequence of operations (SOP) outperforms other representations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GA under the job-based representation outperforms the others in terms of the quality of solutions found and the computational time required.
the GA with the representation that is based on the job sequence and the machine sequence is the best one.
the GA representation that is based on the job permutation is superior to the others.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the GA’s performance is not only dependent on the chosen representation but also dependent on the problem instance.
the representation is not a critical factor for the GA performance.
the GA representation is an important issue to be addressed in order to achieve better performance in solving the JSP.
